display_title: Love and WiFi in the Palace

titles_en.title: Love and WiFi in the Palace

description:
Sohyang, a court lady from Joseon era, and Taepung, a webtoon author who needs inspiration for his new work. There was a 200 years difference between them but an old drawer connected the two. The story of Sohyang, who is trying to get the king's heart with the help of Taepung, will soon become the idea for Taepung's new webtoon. What would happen to both of them, who live in different era?
